solutions.title: Recursive ancestor bounds
solutions.strategy: Pass an exclusive lower and upper bound into each subtree.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is checked once until a violation is found.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack follows tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative bound frames
solutions.strategy: Store each node with the valid value interval it must satisfy.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is popped from the stack once unless validation fails early.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores active branches; in the worst skewed case this can be O(n).
